nodes.description: address private _owner in Ownable; stores the privileged owner address used by onlyOwner.
address private _previousOwner in Ownable; declared but never read or written.
uint256[] public stud in DogeGender; array of pseudo-randomly selected indices pushed by generate().
uint256[] public dam in DogeGender; array of pseudo-randomly selected indices pushed by generate().
uint256 public currentIndex in DogeGender; generation cursor advanced to endIndex in generate().
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender as address payable.
Context._msgData(): returns msg.data.
Ownable.owner(): view returning _owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable constructor: assigns _msgSender() to _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
DogeGender.generate(uint256 length): onlyOwner loop that pseudo-randomly fills stud/dam and advances currentIndex.
DogeGender.StudList(): external view returning the stud array.
DogeGender.DamList(): external view returning the dam array.
DogeGender constructor: empty constructor invoking Ownable's constructor.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment and onlyOwner authorization.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value hashed together with block.number/block.difficulty to derive randomness.
Unchecked arithmetic currentIndex + length (< 10000 comparison) under pragma ^0.6.0; susceptible to overflow.
Pseudo-randomness derived from keccak256(block.number, block.timestamp, block.difficulty, i) and parity modulo; predictable/manipulable.
onlyOwner require(_owner == _msgSender()) authorization gate protecting generate() and renounceOwnership().
Parameter length of generate(); controls the number of indices generated and participates in unchecked addition.
Loop counter i in generate(); serves as the per-iteration nonce in the keccak256 randomness input.
Local endIndex in generate(); bounded target of the loop, computed from currentIndex + length.
Local hashOfRandom in generate(); keccak256 digest of block data and loop index.
Local numberRepresentation in generate(); uint256 cast of the hash whose parity decides stud vs dam.
Local msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() before it is written to _owner.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is consumed inside generate() as part of the keccak256 randomness input, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp flows directly into the pseudo-randomness unsafe operation that decides stud/dam membership.
msg.sender is returned by _msgSender().
_msgSender() result is compared against _owner in the onlyOwner require check.
_owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner authorization check.
Caller-controlled msg.sender participates in the owner authorization decision.
Local msgSender is produced inside the Ownable constructor from _msgSender().
The Ownable constructor writes _owner with the derived msgSender value.
generate() execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership() execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership() sets _owner to address(0), changing the privilege holder.
generate() computes currentIndex + length inside its loop bounds calculation under an unchecked 0.6.0 arithmetic context.
Caller-supplied length parameter feeds directly into the unchecked currentIndex + length sum.
currentIndex state variable is an operand of the unchecked addition producing endIndex.
endIndex is derived from the length parameter through the bounded comparison.
The arithmetic result endIndex is written back to currentIndex, advancing generation state.
generate() reads currentIndex to initialize the loop and enforce the 10000 cap.
Loop index i is hashed into keccak256, feeding the pseudo-randomness operation.
hashOfRandom is cast to uint256 as numberRepresentation.
numberRepresentation % 2 parity decides stud versus dam, making the branch deterministically predictable from public block data.
Pseudo-random parity causes i to be pushed into stud.
Pseudo-random parity causes i to be pushed into dam.
generate() writes to the stud array via push.
generate() writes to the dam array via push.
StudList() returns the stud array.
DamList() returns the dam array.

normalization_plan.reason: The length parameter has no independent security meaning; it exists only as the operand of the unchecked currentIndex + length computation, so it should be absorbed into that arithmetic unsafe operation.
Loop counter i is only used as the per-iteration nonce of the keccak256 pseudo-randomness input and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
endIndex is the temporary result of the unchecked addition and exists solely to bound the loop, so it belongs to the arithmetic unsafe operation.
hashOfRandom is a transient intermediate of the weak randomness derivation and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
numberRepresentation is the parity-bearing value that drives the pseudo-random branch and is only meaningful inside the randomness unsafe operation.
The msgSender local exists only within the Ownable constructor to initialize _owner and should be merged into that function.
